description: August 25 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 1, birthday number 7, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an August 25 birthday falls in Virgo, in the first decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 7. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: August 25 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Mercury rules both Virgo and its first decan, so August 25th, two degrees into the sign, is strongly analytical in traditional terms. Seven, the number of inquiry, intensifies the effect. This birthday is often pictured as a thoughtful perfectionist who loves understanding how things work, and who benefits from occasionally accepting good enough.

On August 25 the Sun usually sits at about 2° Virgo, in the first decan, where Mercury rules the decan as well as the sign. Mercury rules Virgo and also governs its opening decan, from about August 23 to September 2. Doubled Mercury in an earth sign points towards analysis, method and a talent for noticing the detail everyone else walked past. People with these birthdays are often called helpful, articulate and quietly witty, with high standards for their own work. The flip side is a busy mind that can turn on itself, cataloguing flaws long after the job is done. Their best gift tends to be useful precision: making a system clearer, a text tighter or a routine kinder to the people who follow it.

sections.heading: August 25 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 25th, your compound 2 + 5 reduces to 7. The 2's intuition and the 5's curiosity come together in the 7's reflective, analytical temperament. People born on the 25th are frequently described as perceptive, observant and drawn to understanding how things and people really work. They may test ideas through experience before trusting them. In its secondary role, the 25 is traditionally linked with a strong inner voice and a need for quiet time to process what they have gathered. Their insight often becomes valuable to others once they decide to share it.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one August 25 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on August 25: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: An August birthday falls in late northern summer, a season of early harvests and holidays, and in late winter for the southern hemisphere, when the first blossom starts to appear. Leo holds most of the month, with Virgo arriving around August 22 or 23. August is month 8 in numerology, associated with ambition, authority and material skill, a fitting partner for Leo's confidence. August 25 is the 237th day of the year (238th in a leap year). By September 23, 29 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Libra.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by August 25, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on August 25 include Sean Connery (1930), Johann Gottfried Herder (1744) and Erich Honecker (1912).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is August 25?
faq.answer: August 25 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on August 25?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On August 25 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 7 for everyone born on the 25th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on August 25?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an August 25 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on August 25?
faq.answer: August 25 is also the birthday of Sean Connery (1930), Johann Gottfried Herder (1744) and Erich Honecker (1912). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
